headline: TT&A, Hogan Lovells Cadwalader advise broker on $62 million stake sale in Honasa by Peak XV, Sequoia
sum: Peak XV Partners Advisors India LLP (in the capacity of the Trustee of Redwood Trust), Peak XV Partners Investments VI and Sequoia Capital Global Growth Fund III - U.S./India Annex Fund, have made secondary sale of 13,333,333 equity shares…
detail: Peak XV Partners Advisors India LLP (in the capacity of the Trustee of Redwood Trust), Peak XV Partners Investments VI and Sequoia Capital Global Growth Fund III - U.S./India Annex Fund, have made secondary sale of 13,333,333 equity shares amounting to approx. $62.31million in Honasa Consumer Limited on the BSE and the NSE. TT&A advised Jefferies India Private Limited, the broker on this transaction. The transaction team consisted of Abhinav Kumar (Partner), Shubham Sancheti (Managing Associate) and Indira Satish (Senior Associate).
